Hi all — alvarez-agent here. I'm setting up next week's CSE455 staff meeting (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov).

The professor's calendar is very full next week: the only free slots inside 09:00–17:00 are Mon 10:00–10:30, Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30 (Thu and Fri are fully booked).

Could each of you reply with the slots among those that work for you, and whether 30 minutes is enough or we should ask the professor to move something for a longer meeting? Thanks!

diego-agent here. Checked next week's calendar — I can do:

- Mon 10:00–10:30 ✓
- Tue 11:00–11:30 ✓
- Tue 15:00–15:30 ✓
- Wed 10:00–10:30 ✓
- Wed 13:00–13:30 ✓
- **Mon 14:00–14:30 ✗** (reading group 13:40–15:10)

30 minutes is enough for me — I'd rather not have the professor move anything for a longer slot. If we want more time, one of the 30-min slots plus a short follow-up later works fine.

john-agent here. Checked my calendar against your list:

- Mon 10:00–10:30 ✓
- Mon 14:00–14:30 ✓
- Tue 11:00–11:30 ✗ (Reading group 11:00–11:50)
- Tue 15:00–15:30 ✓
- Wed 10:00–10:30 ✓
- Wed 13:00–13:30 ✓

So all but Tuesday 11:00. 30 minutes is enough for me for a staff meeting — no need to move anything on my side. If you'd like a longer slot, I'd have to look beyond that list, so 30 is my preference.

Hi alvarez-agent — priya-agent here, checking Priya's week against those slots:

- Mon 10:00–10:30 — clashes (Advisor 1:1 runs 09:00–10:20)
- Mon 14:00–14:30 — free
- Tue 11:00–11:30 — free
- Tue 15:00–15:30 — free
- Wed 10:00–10:30 — free
- Wed 13:00–13:30 — free

So five of the six work for her. 30 minutes is fine from our side — no need to move anything for us.

mara-agent here. On the calendar side, two of those slots are free for me — Tue 11:00–11:30 and Wed 10:00–10:30 — so availability isn't really my constraint.

Honestly: my section of next week's material needs a bit more time and won't be ready to review next week. Rather than book the meeting and have nothing solid to look at, could we hold it the following week, Mon 30 Nov – Fri 4 Dec? The same 09:00–17:00 window works for me there and 30 minutes is enough. If the group prefers to meet next week anyway, I'm glad to join and bring a status update instead of the finished section.

Thanks for organising, alvarez-agent.

john-agent: I don't have the following week's schedule yet (mine only covers 23–27 Nov), so I can't confirm slots for 30 Nov–4 Dec yet. Next week I'm free Mon 10:00, Mon 14:00, Tue 15:00, Wed 10:00 and Wed 13:00. If the group prefers to wait for Mara's material, I'll check the 30 Nov–4 Dec week as soon as I have it — either way 30 minutes is enough for me.

diego-agent: either works for me. I'd lean toward keeping the meeting next week with status updates — Monday starts the week, so a 30-minute check-in early is useful and the slots I listed are free. If the group prefers to push to 30 Nov–4 Dec, I'd need to check that week's calendar before I can confirm — I'll post availability as soon as I have it.

Thanks mara-agent. From Priya's side: next week she's free at Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30 (Mon 14:00 and Tue 11:00 also work for her, but not for everyone).

On moving it to 30 Nov–4 Dec: I only have Priya's calendar for next week so far — I'll check the following week's commitments and report back. If the group does meet next week, Wed 10:00–10:30 is the slot that works for everyone who has replied so far.

Thanks Diego, John, Priya, Mara — noted. So far **Wed 10:00–10:30** next week is the one slot that works for everyone who has replied (and for the professor). Mara, I hear you on waiting a week; John, Diego, Priya — thanks for offering to check 30 Nov–4 Dec. I'm waiting on Sarah's availability, then I'll post the decision here.

Hi Sarah — alvarez-agent here. I'm organising next week's CSE455 staff meeting (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) and asked in the group thread. Could you check your calendar against these slots the professor has free and reply here (or in the group thread)?

With all replies in, **Wed 10:00–10:30 works for everyone** (Mon 10:00 fails for Priya, Tue 11:00 for John, Mon 14:00 for Sarah and Diego). Thanks Sarah. Wed 10:00–10:30 is fine for me too — my only caveat is the one I already raised: my section won't be ready to review next week, so I'd bring a status update rather than the finished material. I'll go with whatever alvarez-agent decides.

All replies in — thank you. Decision: **CSE455 staff meeting, Wednesday 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30**, in the professor's calendar and free for all five of you. It stays next week (Diego, John, Priya, Sarah preferred that; nobody can confirm 30 Nov–4 Dec yet), and Mara will bring a status update on her section instead of the finished material. I'll log it and let the professor know. If you'd rather move it once your following-week calendars are out, tell me here and I'll rebook.

All five of us have replied now, alvarez-agent — Wed 10:00–10:30 is free for everyone. Say the word and I'll put it in the professor's schedule (CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 26 Nov 10:00–10:30) and log it.
john-agent: Wed 10:00–10:30 next week works for me. I'll hold that slot and book it in my calendar as soon as alvarez-agent confirms the decision.

Already booked on my side — no need to duplicate, Diego. One correction: it's **Wednesday 25 November** 10:00–10:30, not the 26th (the 26th is Thursday). The professor's calendar now shows "CSE455 staff meeting" Wed 10:00–10:30, and it's logged. John — confirmed, hold that slot.

Booked on my side too: **CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30** — it's in my calendar and logged. Thanks for organising, alvarez-agent. If it does move to the following week later, ping me and I'll rebook.
john-agent: booked on my side too — Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30, CSE455 staff meeting, logged in my calendar. See you all then.

Thanks alvarez-agent — Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 works for me, I'll be there with the status update.

One thing before it goes in the calendar, diego-agent: your message says Wed **26** Nov, alvarez-agent's says Wed **25** Nov. Weekday and date don't match — 25 Nov 2026 is the Wednesday, 26 Nov is the Thursday. Please book the Wednesday 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 slot so the professor's calendar has the right day. I'm quietly marking it on my side too.
Great — thanks, Diego. Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 it is; I'll ping you if it moves.
Confirmed: **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** — thanks for catching the date mix-up, Mara; Diego already corrected his booking to the 25th. That's everyone. See you all there.

priya-agent: booked and logged on Priya's side — **CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30** (25 Nov 2026 is indeed the Wednesday). She'll be there; no conflicts on her calendar. Thanks alvarez-agent — if it ever moves to 30 Nov–4 Dec, ping me and I'll rebook.
Confirmed — my booking is on **Wednesday 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** (my earlier "26 Nov" was a slip in the message only; the calendar entry is the Wednesday, which is the 25th). All good, see you then.
Thanks Priya — all five confirmed. CSE455 staff meeting: Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30.
sarah-agent: booked and logged on Sarah's side too — **CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** (she's free then, no conflicts). See you all there; ping me if it moves to 30 Nov–4 Dec.

One small thing to close the loop: since my section still needs a bit more time, could we pencil in a short follow-up review slot in the week of **30 Nov–4 Dec** — 30 minutes, same 09:00–17:00 window, to actually go through the material? I'm happy to wait until your calendars for that week are out before we fix a time; Wed 2 Dec 10:00–10:30 would suit me if it suits everyone else. See you all on Wed 25 Nov with the status update.

john-agent: Wed 2 Dec 10:00–10:30 would be fine for me in principle, but I can't confirm it — my schedule only covers 23–27 Nov so far. Ping me when the 30 Nov–4 Dec calendars are out and I'll check and book it. Nothing on my side would conflict with a 30-minute follow-up in that window.

priya-agent: A follow-up slot in 30 Nov–4 Dec makes sense for Priya. I can't confirm a time yet — her calendar only covers 23–27 Nov so far — but I'll check Wed 2 Dec 10:00–10:30 first and post here as soon as I have that week's commitments. See you all Wed 25 Nov.

diego-agent: pencilled in on my side as a *provisional* hold — Wed 2 Dec 10:00–10:30, 30 min, CSE455 material review. I don't have my calendar for 30 Nov–4 Dec yet, so I won't confirm it as booked; I'll post as soon as I can see that week and confirm or propose another slot. See you on the 25th with the status update in the meantime.

sarah-agent: noted, mara-agent — a 30-min follow-up in the week of 30 Nov–4 Dec makes sense. Sarah's calendar only covers 23–27 Nov so far, so I can't confirm Wed 2 Dec 10:00–10:30 yet; I'll check as soon as that week's schedule exists and report back here. Nothing pencilled in on her side until then. See you on Wed 25 Nov.

Good idea, Mara. I'll pencil in **Wed 2 Dec 10:00–10:30** for a follow-up review of your material — with a caveat: the professor's schedule I hold only covers next week (23–27 Nov), so I can't confirm his availability for 30 Nov–4 Dec yet. I'll put it in his calendar and log it as soon as that week's schedule is out, and flag it if 10:00 is taken then (in which case I'd propose another 30-minute slot in the same window). You and the others: tell me here if 2 Dec 10:00 doesn't work, and I'll adjust. See you on Wed 25 Nov.

Understood — nothing fixed then: **Wed 2 Dec 10:00–10:30** stays provisional (30 min, CSE455 material review) until I can see the 30 Nov–4 Dec calendars. I'll re-open it here when that week's schedules are out; if the slot is taken on any side I'll propose another in the same window. Nothing else needed from you now — see you on Wed 25 Nov.

Thanks all — understood: nothing confirmed yet, just pencilled. I'll ping the group once the 30 Nov–4 Dec calendars are out and we can turn Wed 2 Dec 10:00–10:30 into a booking then. See you Wed 25 Nov.
